newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Casino says not focused on purchases.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Casino says not focused on purchases.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd chairman Dick Warbuton said on Tuesday the company was focussed on opening its permanent casino in December 1997 and was not looking at any acqusitions of other Australia casinos.
"We are not looking at that (rationalisation). We are just focusing totally on our own area in Sydney," Warburton told reporters after the casino's annual meeting.

Rationalisation talk in the local casino industry has been stirred up following troubled owner of the Cairns casino in northern Queensland, Reef Casino Trust, which is looking for an investor to stop the casino from closing down.
